tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid lam gyi yon tan skye 'gyur smon lam mngon 'dod mdza' na 'gugs pa'i phrin snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// pra ṇi dha na sid+dhir bha wa tu/ mkhyen brtse nus pa dpag yas bla ma dang*// thugs rje che sogs yi dam lha yi tshogs// rgyal ba sras slob bstan srung bcas pa la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyis mdun bdar nas// tshe rabs phreng ba'i sdig ltung mthol zhing bshags// 'khor 'das dge bar yi rang 'dzum gyis bsu// chos smra chos sgra 'byin pa'i dbyangs snyan bskul// zhi bar phyogs rnams bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge tshogs gzhan don rnam mkhyen thob phyir bsngo// smon lam 'bras bu grub pa khyed cag gis// bdag gi smon lam snye ma g.yur za mdzod// dam chos bsgrub la med thabs med pa'i rten// dal 'byor mi ste de ni rgyu rkyen dang*// ngo bor bsams pas rnyed dka'i tshul rtogs nas// g.yeng med dam chos srung la brtson par shog /skyes dgu thams cad 'chi ba'i lam chen du// ma song bsdad dbang byung ba su zhig mthong*// bdag kyang de 'dra nam 'chi cha ma 'tshal// mi rtag 'chi bas sems rgyud bskul bar shog /'chi tshe mi dge'i las kyis ngan song 'phen// dge bas mtho ris gsum 'phen bde ba thob// gang phyir lus ngag yid kyi sdig spangs nas// dge bcu sgrub la spro ba brtas par shog /dmyal bar skyes na tsha grang sdug bsngal che// yi dwags bkres skom dud 'gro glen lkugs dang*// gsod gcod sdug bsngal thog babs ji ltar bzod// de rgyu sdig pa'i las las ldog par shog /mi la na shi 'du byed 'pho 'gyur mang*// lha min 'thab rtsod lha dag 'chi 'pho dang*// 'og ma'i sdug bsngal mi bzad myang dgos phyir// khams gsum dpal las yid 'byung skye bar shog /thar pa 'dod kyang gzhan phan blo med par// rang nyid zhe bde don gnyer byis pa'i blos// sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam las ches ring ba'i// blo dman 'ching bu'i dga' ba'ang nyams par shog

/tshe rabs bdag gis pha mar gyur pa'i drin// tshad med kyis bskyangs 'gro bar phan 'dod dang*// sdug bsngal kun 'byung bcas pa bsal 'dod kyi// byams dang snying rje bcos min skye bar shog /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor byings pa'i mar gyur 'gro// sgrol byed bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi// ded dpon mchog de bdag gis thob bya'i phyir// byang chen smon pa'i sems mchog 'byongs par shog /sdug bsngal rtsa ba bdag 'dzin gzhom bya'i phyir// bdag gzhan bde sdug mnyam dang brje ba yi// rgyas sras lam la 'jug pa'i spro ba ches// dge tshogs rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs byed shog /rtog bral gsal snang rtse gcig zhi gnas dang*// chos rnams kun gyi gnas lugs spros bral du// legs rtogs lhag mthong zung 'jug rnal 'byor gyis// bdag 'dzin nyon mongs drungs 'byin bzod par shog /mthar phyin drug dang bsdu bzhi'i spyad pa dag /spyod pas tshogs gnyis zung 'jug gom stabs kyis// sku gsum yon tan dpag yas sar phyin nas// lhun grub phrin las skye dgu'i dpal 'byung shog /thun mong theg pa'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas// khyad par myur lam rdo rje'i theg pa'i sgor// dbang bskur byin rlabs gdams par zhugs pa'i don// rgyud la sbyor phyir spro ba brtas par shog /dngos grub 'byung gnas bla ma dkon mchog gsum// byang chub snying po'i bar gyi skyabs su gzung*// mar gyur 'gro ba sdug bsngal las gdon phyir// sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs la slob par shog /rdor sems thugs rjes sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang*// dus gsum bde gshegs kun 'dus bla ma yi// rnal 'byor bsgom pas sku gsung thugs yon tan// phrin las byin rlabs bdag rgyud 'jug par shog /gzhir gnas skye 'chi bar do'i rnam par rtog /sbyong byed bskyed dang rdzogs pa zung 'jug gi /rnal 'byor bsgom pas sangs rgyas chos gzugs kyi// yon tan bdag gi rgyud la mngon gyur shog

/gsang sngags rgyal po yi ge drug pa'i sgra// skye 'gag bral ba brag ca'i bzlas brjod kyis// yi dam zhi khro'i rnam rol grangs med kyi// zhal mthong dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub par shog /rjes thob snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lha// sgra skad thams cad grag stong sngags kyi gdangs// dran bsam rig stong dbyer med ye shes kyi// rnam rol dag pa'i snang ba 'byong bar shog /zas gos gnas mal gnyid du yur ba rnams// tha mal bden zhen 'ching ba las grol ba// sgyu ma'i skyes bu rtse 'jor rol ba ltar// lam gyi yon tan bskyed grogs 'char bar shog /nam zhig 'chi tshe lus sems zug rngu bral// bla ma yi dam lha dang rang sems gsum// dbyer med 'phos pas mkha' 'gro'i dbang po ltar// sangs rgyas zhing kun thogs med bgrod par shog /gal te 'phos don grub par ma gyur na// rnam shes 'od gsal la thim stong gsal gyi// ting 'dzin skye ba 'chi ba chos kyi sku'i// rang zhal 'od gsal ma bu mjal bar shog /'od gsal las ldang bar dor 'khrul gyur na// cir snang lha sngags ye shes bsgyur ba'i 'phral// rnam grol longs skur grub pa'i phrin las kyis// mkha' mnyam 'gro la phan bde sgrub par shog /mdor na kun 'dus bdag nyid bla ma lhas// rjes su bzung nas po ta la ri dang*// bde ba can sogs dag pa'i zhing bgrod cing*// 'gro ba rgya mtsho smin par byed par shog /de thob bar gyi tshe rabs dal 'byor ldan// bla ma lhag pa'i lha'i rjes bzung nas// phyi nang shes bya'i yul la blo gros rgyas// bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i byed por shog /lam rim yon tan smon pa'i 'phrin snyan 'di// mngon 'dod kun dga' bskyed pa'i mdza' na 'os// thos pa'i mod la byang chen gtan gyi grogs// 'bral med thob pa'i dga' bdes rtsen par shog /ces thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid lam rim gyi yon tan skye 'gyur smon lam mngon 'dod mdza' na 'gugs pa'i 'phrin snyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/

lam 'dir zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa kram gyi phur tsha bla ma ngag dbang tshul khrims zhes bya bas bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul rin du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa'o// // ༄༅// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'dod don smon lam bde legs mdza' bo 'gugs pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// phyogs bcu'i thams cad mkhyen pa sras dang bcas// kun 'du bdag nyid mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter// sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzad pas bdag skyong ba// dpal ldan bla ma mchog rnams gtsug tu mchod// rgyal ba rigs drug rang rigs dga' mar bcas// sems dpa' che brgyad mchod pa'i gzungs ma drug /bgegs sgra khro bo phyogs kyi grangs mnyam bdag /rtsa ba'i bla ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon// gang la sdom gsum brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yi dam sangs rgyas chos dang rgyal ba'i sras// nyan thos rang rgyal bstan srung nor lha yis// kun nas bskor ba'i mchod yul thams cad la// bdag lus grangs med sprul ba dang 'dod dang*// yid ches dad pa'i khur chen ma bzod par// yan lag rnam lnga mdun gyi g.yar lam du// lan grangs brgya stong ngal gsor spyod snyam bgyid// nyer spyod mchod pas rdzogs ldan sprin la 'phya// ye shes bdud rtsi'i mtsho rlabs 'bum phrag g.yo// yid sprul ci 'dod sgyu 'phrul ltad mo ngom// spros bral bde stong bla med mchod pa 'bul// so thar byang sems sngags kyi sdom pa yi// bslab bya'i dam bca' dral ba'i nyes ltung rnams// stobs bzhi tshang ba'i skal ldan shing rta chus// bkrus ltar skyon med dag pa'i rang bzhin stsol// 'phags bzhi so skyes mngon par 'du bgyis pa'i// bsod nams ji snyed rjes su yi rang gi /'dzum zer bklubs pa gangs ldan ri bo las// ston zla'i 'od kyis 'khyud ltar ches dkar bgyi// phyogs bcu'i ston pa mchog rnams zhi dbyings kyi// mal du gzims la dgongs pa mngon phyogs rnams// sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam dran bskul gyis// 'gro don rtag par 'tsho gzhes bzhugs par gsol// snyigs ma'i gdon chen gyis myos gti mug gi

/gnyid du yur ba sad byed tshangs pa'i dbyangs// rnga chen las 'phos chos kyi dbyangs ldir bar// smra ba'i skyes mchog rnams la gsol ba 'debs// des bskyed dge ba'i sa bon stobs bdo bas// skye ba'i phreng bar dal 'byor rkang pas 'thungs// byang chub spyod pa'i yal 'dab rgyas pa'i khrod// don gnyis grub pa'i snye mas dud par shog /mkhyen brtse nus mtha' kun gsal 'doms pas kyang*// gzhal du med pa'i skyabs mchog khyed rnams kyis// bdag cag bsam pa'i don kun smon lam gyis// snying por dril ba mtha' dag don yod mdzod// sngon gyi che mchog rnams kyis byang chub tu// thugs bskyed spyod pa'i smon lam ci yang btab// gang phyir de dag rnams kyi sems can don// 'bad med grub pa'i rjes su bslab par bgyi// dal 'byor rten bzang sdug bsngal kun 'byung gi /rgyu 'bras mi bzad 'khor bar ma chags par// nges 'byung thar pa 'dod pa'i blo gros kyis// bslu med skyabs gsum gtsug gi rgyan du bsrel// skyabs su song ba'i bslab gzhi tshul khrims gtsang*// bzo gso sgra tshad sdeb sbyor mngon brjod dang*// skad rigs bzhi dang snyan ngag zlos pa'i gar// skar nag rtsis gzhung legs sbyangs pha rol son// chos don yongs 'dzin smra mkhas dge ba'i bshes// gus pas nyer bsten theg chen lam gyi gzhi// bka' srol chen po las brgyud sdom pa yi// rgyal ba'i myu gu dam pa'i rigs skyer shog /mar gyur yid can mtha' med 'khor ba las// gdon pa'i thabs mchog sde snod gsum gyi chos// legs sbyangs tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab kyi// bslab pa'i gnas la ngoms med spyod par shog /ches zab rdo rje'i theg pa'i chu gter cher// 'jug byed dbang bskur rnam bzhi'i grur zhugs nas// dam tshig sdom pa'i ba dan spyod 'gros mkhan// rig sngags 'chang gi ded dpon mchog tu gyur// 'gro blo'i bye brag 'dod par spyod tshul bzhi// phyi nang cha mnyam gtsor spyod gdul bya'i ngor// legs gsungs rgyud sde rnam bzhi mtha' drug dang*// tshul chen bzhi dang rgyan bdun gnad la sgrin// mtha' bral lta ba'i yul la ma rmongs shing*// bskyed rdzogs bsgom pas ting 'dzin sgo brgya phye// bzlas brjod gtor ma las tshogs rab 'byams kyis// bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen byed par shog

/de ltar zab dang rgya che'i rnal 'byor la// brtan pa mchog bskyed ches cher goms stabs kyis// drod thob spyod pas rtogs pa brtan byas nas// gsang chen nang gi sa lam bgrod par shog /chos sku spros bral mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid// longs sku nges pa lnga ldan dge mtshan 'bar// grangs med sprul sku'i 'gro don rgyun chags dang*// lhun grub 'byung ba'i 'bras bu mngon 'gyur shog /bla med byang chub mchog de thob 'dod kyi// 'dun pa'i spro ba dge ba'i phyogs gtad mod// nyon mongs le lo'i mdza' bo g.yon can gyis// yid kyi skyes bu log lam 'khrid ma gyur// gal te sems can phan 'dogs stobs chen ldan// rang rgyud byang chub spyod pa bla nas blar// 'phel ba'i grogs su 'gyur de skye ba'i gnas// gang du skyes pa'i sgo de mi 'gog kyang*// dge chos sgrub pa'i skal bas ches dben pa'i// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro kla klo dang*// log par lta dang lkugs pa lha tshe ring*// sangs rgyas kyis stongs mi khom skye ma gyur// yul dbus mi lus mchog skye dbang po tshang*// gnas la dad dang las mtha' ma log par// sangs rgyas byon dang chos gsungs bstan pa gnas// bstan pa'i rjes 'jug snying brtse'i 'byor pa ldan// 'khor ba'i phun tshogs dug gi lo ma la// sred zhen zos pas thar pa'i srog dang rtsa// nges par 'grog pa'i nyes dmigs shes nas ni// thar pa'i phyogs la blo mig gtod par shog /kun mkhyen dam pa'i lung dang rdzogs pa'i bstan// gsal byed chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa// brtse chen snying po brgyud par bcas rnams kyi// ring lugs dri med nam yang 'bral ma gyur// rgyal gsung tam+bu ra las lung bstan gyi// dbyangs snyan rna ba'i dpyid 'jo e waṃ pa// kun dga' bzang po rgyal tshab rim byon gyis// legs gsungs bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i skal ldan gyur// thabs shes yi ges mtshan bstan bshad sgrub kyi// bya bas skyong ba'i 'dus tshogs dmar ba'i mdangs// phyogs mtshams nor 'dzin bu mo'i mkhur tshos la// 'phos pa'i dga' bas rnam drug g.yo snyam gyur// tshuṃl khriṃms brtul zhugs la gnas phyi nang gi

/gtsug lag riṃn cheṃn snang ba yongs bzung nas// chos dang sems can phan pa'i phrin las can// skye kun rigs kyi bdag po thob gyur cig /thams cad mkhyen rgyu bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhung*// smra mkhas phrin las lhuṃn gruṃb rgyun mi chad// dbang 'byor mkhas tshul gsum gyis bstan dang 'gror// phunaṃ tshogaṃs phan bde'i 'byung gnas nyid gyur cig /sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i rdul snyed mchod pa dang*// chos rab ston pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la// mchod pa'i bsod nams skal mnyam rgyal ba'i bka'// tshad mas mngon par bsngags la yid ches nas// mchod pa'i tshul 'dir rgyu sbyor las bzang gi /'brel thogs kyis mtshon 'gro tshogs skye nas skyer// chos smra mkhas pa rnams kyi zhabs bsnyen te// sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i las la rab tu brtson// 'bum phrag bskal par bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams// skyabs gsum mchod pa'i dge bas legs sbyangs nas// rtag tu bde ldan mgon po bcom ldan 'das// 'od dpag med pa'i zhabs drung skye bar shog /de nas slar yang mngon dga'i zhing la sogs// thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis bgrod rgyal ba'i gsung*// 'gags med lhun grub las 'phos chos kyi sgra// mnyan cing dran pas 'dzin pa'i sras su gyur// dngos grub 'byung gnas bla ma dkon mchog la// mchod pa'i phan yon mu med la chags nas// 'di nas ma 'ongs bskal pa'i skye 'gro cog /mchod pa'i rgyun 'dir spro ba bskyungs ma gyur// ljongs 'dis mtshon pa'i yul grur 'khod dgu rnams// nad yam gdon bgegs 'tshe ba dus min 'chi'i// bar chad thams cad dkon mchog thugs rje yis// mun pa sgron mes bcom ltar zhi gyur cig /'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho'i lo legs bskyed pa la// 'bras bu'i ro bcud 'phrog byed grang sad dang*// btsa' nad then pa rdo char dgra dpung rnams// mi 'byung bsrung ba'i gur khyim chud gyur cig

/mthun rkyen bsod nams 'byor pa'i rgya mtsho 'khyil// 'khor 'das tshe bcud chu klung brgya phrag 'bab// dge bcur spyod pa'i 'gro ba'i mkha' lding rnams// bde dga' skyid pa'i mgrin glu len gyur cig /gangs ri bzhu ba'i byin za stong pa'i mkha'// chag pa'i dum bzhin dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'// bden pas bslus pa srid pa min pa'i mthus// smon lam gang btab snye ma g.yur za shog /bstan 'dzin skyes chen rnams kyi sku tshe brtan// bstan pa'i rjes 'jug dge 'dun grangs med 'dus// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rigs stobs dpal 'byor 'phel// bstan pa dar rgyas 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /ces gzhi lam 'bras bu'i skabs kyi 'dod don smon lam du dril ba bde legs mdza' bo 'gugs pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bla ma mchod pa sogs kyi tshogs 'don dang*/ rgyun du'ang 'don byar 'os pa 'di ltar dgos zhes slob bu dge slong lhun grub phun tshogs can gyis bskul pa'i ngor/ shākya'i ban+de ngag dbang tshul khrims rin chen nam/ 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i tshul gyis ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes btags pas/ kun 'dzin zhes bya'i gnam lo'i sgrol byed lha mo smin drug gis nya pa'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor 'dzom pa'i nyin/ dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyogs ba gam gsum par bris pa sarbār+tha sid+dho bha wa tu// ༈ //kun khyab rigs brgya'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang*// bi rū pa dang grub brnyes brgyad cu bzhi// bstan pa'i snang byed zhi 'tsho pad+ma 'byung*// rje 'bangs gter byon brgyud pa thams cad dang*// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gsal byed sa skya pa// yab sras khu dbon gdung rabs rim byon dang*// thub pa'i lung zin rje btsun e waṃ pa// gang de'i khri la mnga' gsol gang dag byon// mdo sngags bstan pa'i rjes 'jug grangs med kyis// dbyig 'dzin dog por bgyid pa blo bzang grags// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug karma pa// cod paṇa dmar nag 'chang ba brgyud par bcas// pad+ma ka ra'i thugs sprul sems can gyi// 'gro don dpag yas thang stong rgyal po ste// thugs rje che ldan rnams la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so bsam don kun 'grub mdzod// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub sbyin pa'i phyag

/dpag bsam yal ga lta bur ma bskums par// ci 'dod bsam pa rgyud chen rnam pa bzhis// nyer bsten gsang sngags gsar rnying yi dam lha// snang srid chos kun dag pa ye shes kyi// rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo'i gzugs rnam can// dngos grub 'byung gnas kun la skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so bsam don kun 'grub mdzod// lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma 'od po ches// khams gsum 'gro ba'i snying gi mun bcom nas// thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'dab stong tshal// mtha' dag cig car phye ba shākya'i tog /gang la phyogs bcu mu med zhing khams na// lus med thul mchog dbang po gang dag bzhugs// de sras 'gro ba srid pa'i chu gter las// gdon pa'i snying stobs rmad byung sems dpa'i tshogs// ston pa'i rnam 'phrul bstan pa skyong byed pa'i// gnas brtan bcu drug dgra bcom 'khor tshogs bcas// thams cad 'di nas brtser dgongs skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so bsam don kun 'grub mdzod// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan// phrin las bsam mi khyab bdag 'jam dpal dbyangs// spyan ras gzigs dbang dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag /srid gsum 'byung po 'dul sogs zhi khro'i gar// 'khor ba ngan song 'jigs sgrol tshe dang dpal// rgyas mdzad phrin las myur ma'i lha tshogs bcas// bdag sogs don phyir 'dir gshegs skyabs su mchi// gsol ba 'debs so bsam don kun 'grub mdzod// bsten cing mchod pa'i bka' srung mthu bo che// ye shes spyan ldan rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po lcam dral dang*// zhing skyong gdong bzhi ldan pa yum chen bzhi// skye 'gro'i srog bdag gnod sbyin pho mo dang*// pu tra bha ṭa srin mo kha 'bar ma// ru 'dren sde tshogs phyag bzhi phyag drug dang*// dur khrod yab yum dmag zor re wa tī// phyogs skyong bcu dang dam can chos kyi rgyal// beg tse lcam sring 'jigs rung 'khor tshogs bcas// drag rtsal che ldan thams cad tshur dgongs la// bdag gi bsam don 'grub pa'i phrin las zhu// lha mi gdengs can snying gi brtan pa dag

/rang dbang phrogs nas 'dod dgu'i dpal 'jo ba'i// rig byed dga' ma 'dod rgyal tshogs kyi bdag /rnam mang thos sras rmugs 'dzin ser nag dang*// nor gyi rgyun ma gzhan mi thub pa sogs// yid la ci 'dod re ba 'bad med du// sbyin mdzad nor lha'i tshogs rnams bdag lus dang*// 'bral med 'grogs nas bsam don kun 'grub mdzod// mtsho skyes rdo rje'i spyan sngar bod yul gyi// bstan dang sems can skyong ba khas blangs pa'i// brtan ma bcu gnyis gangs can ti se dang*// thang lha yar bzhud rma gnyan spom ra dang*// zla rgyal 'phan phyug gnyan po sde 'khor bcas// rdo rje g.yung drung rdo rje blo gros kyis// nyer mtshon ri dbang rgyal po mched dgu dang*// rdo rje rdzong dmar mo nam ge mdzo gnyan// dbu che pa ra can dang ra yig gi /mtha' can bzhi dang rtse rgyal zhal ta ba// a mye rma tham bon po rnga khur te// de dag rang rang 'khor tshogs bcas pa dang*// yul ljongs de rnams nyen skor khor yug gi /sa chu rdo shing mtsher sa grong khang la// nye bar gnas pa'i lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs// bdag gi kha 'dzin ched du 'bod do byon// kye skyabs yul che mchog yon tan ldan pa yi// phyag 'os mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gaṅgā'i chus// bdag sogs tshe rabs bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams// legs bkrus dwangs pa'i shel ltar gsal bar mdzod// bsod nams zhing gyur dad gsum zhing sa la// dge sdig blang dor ma nor chu lud bran// rnam gsum sdom pa'i sa bon gang btab pa// bag yod bslab pa'i myu gu cher rgyas mdzod// gnas skabs mthar thug mngon par 'dod pa yi// snye ma g.yur du za ba'i 'bras bzang gi /dga' ston gya nom rang gzhan thar pa dang*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsos sman 'gyed par mdzod// mthar thug 'bras bu re smin de srid du// ngan 'gror 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skye sgo las// nges par bsgral nas dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i rten// sangs rgyas chos dang phrad pa'i skal bzang mdzod// sgo gsum bar chad nad dang gdon rigs dang*// byad gtad rbad zor mi mthun mun 'thibs tshe// skyabs mchog rnams kyi thugs rje'i 'od stong gis// skad cig gnyis par mi gnas zhi bar mdzod// 'chi med ring 'tsho tshe yi chu gter klong*// bsod nams 'byor pa'i chu skyes 'bum bzhad par// dge chos spyod pa'i sbrang rtsi'i mgrin snyan can// kun nas rtsen pa'i dga' bder rgyas par mdzod// ye shes 'jig rten mchod yul thun mong gis// bdag cag gzhir sdod byes bgrod rnam pa kun// nyes brgya mi mthun phyogs las bsrung ba dang*// mthun rkyen legs brgya sbyor ba'i stong grogs bcol// srid skyong mkhar brtsig 'dun gros so nam rtsom// phyogs su don gnyer lam zhugs tshong skyed dang*// zong sgrub la sogs brnag don gang dang gang*// bya ba de de'i dpal kun bskyed mdzod cig

/lus rtsal 'phong skyen rgyan 'gyed rgyal skugs 'gran// ngag snyan shag 'debs brgal zhing brtsad pa dang*// blo gsal gzur gnas khong mdzangs dran 'phrul gyi// rno so bsgrun la ngo mtshar zla med mdzod// gzhan gyi dpal 'byor la rngam blo ngan skyes// rtsal gyis dbrog pa'i dgra dang 'jab bu yis// ma byin len pa'i chom rkun 'tshe ba las// rnam par rgyal ba'i dpung gnyen ci yang mdzod// srid pa'i bde 'byor do ra ches yangs par// nyes pham rgud pa las rgyal skyes bu yi// rtsal dgu rdzogs pa'i rgyan gos kyis bklubs nas// kun dga'i zlos gar stong phrag bsgyur bar mdzod// rgyas par mdzod cig nad med ring 'tsho'i tshe// bde dga' dpal 'byor rgyas pa skabs gsum pa'i// bsod nams phung po ma lus ljongs 'di dang*// yul gru kun tu yongs su 'phos snyam nyid// rnam dkar dge bas bdag dang sems can gyi// sgo gsum dkar min las sgrib kun sbyangs nas// zab dang rgya che'i tshogs zung pha rol son// lus can kun gyi skyabs dang rten gyur cig /ces ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa'i mchod yul rnams la 'bod cing 'dod don gsol ba'i yi ge srid zhi'i gzugs brgya 'char ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sa skyong chen po'i mdun 'khor tshe dbang rab brtan pa rang gi dus rgyun 'dod don zhu yul dmigs bsal gang yod kyi mtshan phreng tho gsal gnang don ltar dgos zhes bskul ngo ma bzlog tsam du/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas thun mtshams su mgyogs par bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// //bla ma yi dam gur lcam dral// gdong bzhi dpal mgon las mgon sde// dmag zor lha mo dur khrod bdag /bstan srung tshogs rnams da tshur dgongs// bdag cag 'gro 'ong lam bar kun// keg 'phrang nyer 'tshe bar chad bgegs// thams cad khyed rnams thugs rje dang*// mthu nus rtsal gyis zhi bar mdzod// ring 'tsho'i tshe dang bsod nams stobs// lung rtogs yon tan phrin las rnams// gong nas gong du 'phel rgyas su// 'byung ba'i phrin las kun 'grub mdzod// ces 'gro 'ong sdod pa'i skabs kyi gegs sel legs smon 'di'ang dgos skabs ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ//
